Ayushman Bharat reaches 60 crore beneficiaries with ₹5 lakh cover

Ayushman Bharat provides ₹5 lakh annual health cover to more than 60 crore beneficiaries. Prime Minister Narendra Modi said on X that this makes it the largest healthcare scheme in the world. The BJP said it is globally number one in hospital admissions.
